blurb: Every locale is held to the reference locale: it must supply each code the reference declares, so that no locale silently lacks a message the reference has. The diagnostic is reported once per missing code, at the locale's block. Add the missing code to the locale. When you add a code to the reference, every other locale must follow. A code that is present with different placeholders is `bynk.messages.placeholder_mismatch`.
summary: A locale is missing a code the reference locale declares.
